text:
David (Partnerships): quick sync — our SI integrator asked what the minimum SOC evidence we can accept for a marketplace listing is, and how their HW attachment bundle should be packaged. also asking about pen-test scope alignment and who owns redaction/presign flows. can we align today?
Maya (Security PM): +1 — need to confirm minimal acceptable artifacts. my current thinking: SOC2 Type II report OR an attestation letter + recent pen-test summary. neither should include raw creds.
Samir (SI Eng): for integrator attachments: they typically include firmware checksums, deployment diagrams, signed attestation PDFs, and pen-test executive summary. we should accept a single ZIP of redacted artifacts + a metadata CSV mapping filenames -> evidence type.
Jen (Legal): SOC2 Type II covering control period within past 12 months is preferable. if they only have SOC2 Type I, we can accept a compensating attestation + vendor questionnaire answered and signed by an officer. we also need an indemnity checkbox on the listing form.
David (Partnerships): @Maya @Jen @Samir if we define the "minimum parity" as: (A) SOC2 Type II OR (B) SOC2 Type I + signed attestation + recent external pen-test exec summary + completed security questionnaire, would that be workable?
Maya (Security PM): yes, that's reasonable. add requirement that pen-test must be within last 18 months and include CVSS-based findings summary (no PII).
Samir (SI Eng): technical note: when partners upload the ZIP, they want presigned S3 links. recommended flow: partner uploads to their S3/secure share, we presign a short-lived inbound URL for our ingestion job. prefer TTL = 7 days. if legal needs longer retention for review, we can extend per-case.
Jen (Legal): 7 days presign for ingestion is ok. but the final archived artifact on our side must be stored in our compliance bucket with restricted access and retention policy 7 years. operators must tag artifact with owner and redaction status.
Partner Ops Bot: Created ticket #PRT-4821 for "Marketplace integrator evidence ingest — SOC/pen alignment" and assigned to @Maya. ETA: 2026-04-02
Maya (Security PM): action items: 1) draft minimum-evidence checklist, 2) update marketplace documentation with attestation language, 3) define presign TTL & ingestion playbook. I'll own. target EOD 2026-03-30.
Samir (SI Eng): will prototype a sample metadata CSV schema and example ZIP layout. sample CSV columns: filename, evidence_type, control_reference, redacted(boolean), contact_email. dropping example here:
```
filename,evidence_type,control_reference,redacted,contact_email
firmware_hashes.txt,artifact,INF-3,false,eng@si.example.com
soc2_attestation.pdf,attestation,CC-1,true,security@si.example.com
pentest_exec_summary.pdf,pen-test,SEC-4,true,security@si.example.com
```
Maya (Security PM): good. include a field for "redaction_notes" in CSV so we know what was stripped.
David (Partnerships): what about export control / HW-sensitive fields? partners are worried about raw telemetry/keys. we should explicitly forbid keys, IP-revealing logs in the upload and provide a redaction guide.
Jen (Legal): agreed. add a required signed attestation checkbox: "No production keys or customer PII included in uploaded artifacts." also require a brief description of redaction steps in the metadata.
Samir (SI Eng): note on pen-test scope: must include network/service boundary for the integrated offering and list of excluded assets. pen-test vendor name + date + CVE summary is fine. we do not need raw test logs.
Maya (Security PM): acceptance criteria for ingest: - CSV present + matches ZIP contents - attestation PDF signed - pen-test exec summary present and within 18 months - redaction_notes present for any redacted file - presigned link expires within configured TTL - owner contact provided
David (Partnerships): propose we add a small "compliance gating" UI step in listing workflow where partner must check boxes and upload metadata. Ops will then trigger automated ingest to our compliance bucket.
Jen (Legal): good. I will draft the attestation text. include language for: 1) validity period of attestation, 2) statement about redaction, 3) permission for us to retain artifacts for regulatory audits.
Samir (SI Eng): for automation: ingestion job will validate CSV <-> ZIP mapping, run simple file-type checks, and flag missing redaction notes. we can post back results to the ticket. I'll add validation scripts to the repo.
Maya (Security PM): timeline recap: Maya draft checklist + ingest playbook by 2026-03-30, Samir prototype metadata + validation by 2026-04-01, Jen draft attestation text by 2026-03-31. David to coordinate partner communication after docs are ready.
David (Partnerships): thanks. one more ask: can we standardize a minimal redaction sample doc for partners to follow? Samir/Maya can we pull a template from previous vendor on-boarding?
Samir (SI Eng): yes — I'll attach a short redaction template to the ticket and include sample sed/grep rules for removing keys and PII.
Maya (Security PM): i'll also add a checklist item for SOC control mapping to our marketplace control catalog.
Jen (Legal): ping me on the draft attestation once ready. I'll run a quick compliance/legal review.
David (Partnerships): perfect. I'll update the partner with this plan and link the ticket. thanks all :thumbsup:
